object.attr: stakeholder: the working copy is what other windows, agents, git clients and comparisons read, so an edit has to be there at once. Text still being typed is a pending edit: where it lands is MELLON-EDIT-SRS-128 and MELLON-EDIT-SRS-129; when the GUI saves it is the GUI area's.
